responsibility: Provides the core target header for the GCN port, defining preprocessor builtins, storage layout, register numbers and names, calling-convention data structures, builtin enums, frame/elimination macros, mode and cost macros, and many target-wide constants used by generated code and backend sources. It is the central declarative description of the GCN machine model that complements gcn.cc’s hook implementations and the .md instruction descriptions.
same_name_distinction: This is the target configuration header for the GCN port: unlike gcn.cc it mainly declares macros, register/layout constants, calling-convention structures, and builtin enums; unlike gcn.md it does not describe RTL instruction patterns; and unlike gcn.opt it is not the source of user option definitions but instead includes and uses the generated option declarations.
